Backend Model
Qwen Runtime Setup Guide
1. Run a reachable Qwen endpoint. The default local URL is http://localhost:8880/v1.
2. If you open Laboon from GitHub Pages, your local runtime must allow browser CORS. Without CORS, the browser will fail before the request reaches Qwen.
3. Preset Voice mode uses a speaker catalog. You can keep the built-in voices or paste your own JSON catalog in AI Config.
4. Voice Design mode uses a natural-language voice prompt. For hosted Alibaba-style voice design flows, a separate create-voice step may still be required by your runtime.
2. Production Language
3. Voice Rendering Mode (Mandatory)
Use a concrete, multi-dimensional voice description. Qwen open-source voice design works best with specific traits such as age, pace, tone, emotion, and use case. Alibaba Cloud voice design docs limit the prompt to 2,048 characters and recommend Chinese or English descriptions.
4. Performance Direction (Mandatory)
